            你还在 for 循环里使用 await？异步循环得这样写
            <!----> <!----></h1> <div class="author-info-block block-hidden" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="author-info-box" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="author-name" data-v-61fb5e44=""><a href="/user/712139234359182/posts" target="_blank" rel="" class="jj-link username username ellipsis" data-v-65b50b51="" data-v-292f6e48="" data-v-61fb5e44=""><span class="name" style="max-width:160px;" data-v-65b50b51="" data-v-292f6e48="">
    冴羽

                  </time> <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="read-icon" data-v-61fb5e44=""><path d="M7.90078 2.80078C4.49278 2.80078 1.74745 6.11672 0.800781 7.77469C1.74745 9.58339 4.49278 13.2008 7.90078 13.2008C11.3088 13.2008 14.0541 9.58339 15.0008 7.77469C14.0541 6.11672 11.3088 2.80078 7.90078 2.80078Z" stroke="currentColor" data-v-61fb5e44=""></path><circle cx="7.89922" cy="8.00078" r="2.2" stroke="currentColor" data-v-61fb5e44=""></circle></svg> <span class="views-count" data-v-61fb5e44="">

                    阅读3分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">1. 前言</h2>
<p>在循环中使用 await，代码看似直观，但运行时要么悄无声息地停止，要么运行速度缓慢，这是为什么呢？</p>
<p>本篇聊聊 JavaScript 中的异步循环问题。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">2. 踩坑 1：for 循环里用 await，效率太低</h2>
<p>假设要逐个获取用户数据，可能会这样写：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> users = [<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>];
<span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> id <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> users) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> user = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUser</span>(id);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(user);
}
</code></pre>
<p>代码虽然能运行，但会<strong>顺序执行</strong>——必须等 <code>fetchUser(1)</code> 完成，<code>fetchUser(2)</code> 才会开始。若业务要求严格按顺序执行，这样写没问题；但如果请求之间相互独立，这种写法就太浪费时间了。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-2">3. 踩坑 2：map 里直接用 await，拿到的全是 Promise</h2>
<p>很多人会在 <code>map()</code> 里用 <code>await</code>，却未处理返回的 Promise，结果踩了坑：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> users = [<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>];
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> results = users.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (id) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> user = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUser</span>(id);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> user;
});
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(results); <span class="hljs-comment">// 输出 [Promise, Promise, Promise]，而非实际用户数据</span>
</code></pre>
<p>语法上没问题，但它不会等 Promise <code>resolve</code>。若想让请求并行执行并获取最终结果，需用 <code>Promise.all()</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> results = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">all</span>(users.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">id</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUser</span>(id)));
</code></pre>
<p>这样所有请求会<strong>同时发起</strong>，<code>results</code> 中就是真正的用户数据了。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-3">4. 踩坑 3：Promise.all 一错全错</h2>
<p>用 <code>Promise.all()</code> 时，只要有一个请求失败，整个操作就会报错：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> results = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">all</span>(
  users.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">id</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUser</span>(id)) <span class="hljs-comment">// 假设 fetchUser(2) 出错</span>
);
</code></pre>
<p>如果 <code>fetchUser(2)</code> 返回 404 或网络错误，<code>Promise.all()</code> 会直接 <code>reject</code>，即便其他请求成功，也拿不到任何结果。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-4">5. 更安全的替代方案</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">5.1. 用 Promise.allSettled()，保留所有结果</h3>
<p>使用 <code>Promise.allSettled()</code>，即便部分请求失败，也能拿到所有结果，之后可手动判断成功与否：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> results = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">allSettled</span>(users.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">id</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUser</span>(id)));

results.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">result</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (result.<span class="hljs-property">status</span> === <span class="hljs-string">"fulfilled"</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"✅ 用户数据:"</span>, result.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>);
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">warn</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"❌ 错误:"</span>, result.<span class="hljs-property">reason</span>);
  }
});
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">5.2. 在 map 里加 try/catch，返回兜底值</h3>
<p>也可在请求时直接捕获错误，给失败的请求返回默认值：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> results = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">all</span>(
  users.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (id) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUser</span>(id);
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (err) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`获取用户<span class="hljs-subst">${id}</span>失败`</span>, err);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { id, <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"未知用户"</span> }; <span class="hljs-comment">// 兜底数据</span>
    }
  })
);
</code></pre>
<p>这样还能避免 “unhandled promise rejections” 错误——在 Node.js 严格环境下，该错误可能导致程序崩溃。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-7">6. 现代异步循环方案，按需选择</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">6.1. for...of + await：适合需顺序执行的场景</h3>
<p>若下一个请求依赖上一个的结果，或需遵守 API 的频率限制，可采用此方案：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 在 async 函数内</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> id <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> users) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> user = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUser</span>(id);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(user);
}
<span class="hljs-comment">// 不在 async 函数内，用立即执行函数</span>
(<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> () =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> id <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> users) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> user = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUser</span>(id);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(user);
  }
})();
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>优点：保证顺序，支持限流</li>
<li>缺点：独立请求场景下速度慢</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">6.2. Promise.all + map：适合追求速度的场景</h3>
<p>请求间相互独立且可同时执行时，此方案效率最高：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> usersData = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">all</span>(users.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">id</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUser</span>(id)));
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>优点：网络请求、CPU 独立任务场景下速度快</li>
<li>缺点：一个请求失败会导致整体失败（需手动处理错误）</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">6.3. 限流并行：用 p-limit 控制并发数</h3>
<p>若需兼顾速度与 API 限制，可借助 p-limit 等工具控制同时发起的请求数量：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> pLimit <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"p-limit"</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> limit = <span class="hljs-title function_">pLimit</span>(<span class="hljs-number">2</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 每次同时发起 2 个请求</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> limitedFetches = users.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">id</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">limit</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUser</span>(id)));
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> results = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">all</span>(limitedFetches);
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>优点：平衡并发和控制，避免压垮外部服务</li>
<li>缺点：需额外引入依赖</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-id="heading-11">7. 注意：千万别在 forEach() 里用 await</h2>
<p>这是个高频陷阱：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript">users.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (id) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> user = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUser</span>(id);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(user); <span class="hljs-comment">// ❌ 不会等待执行完成</span>
});
</code></pre>
<p><code>forEach()</code> 不会等待异步回调，请求会在后台乱序执行，可能导致代码逻辑出错、错误被遗漏。</p>
<p>替代方案：</p>
<ul>
<li>顺序执行：用 for...of + await</li>
<li>并行执行：用 Promise.all() + map()</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-id="heading-12">8. 总结：按需选择</h2>
<p>JavaScript 异步能力很强，但循环里用 await 要“按需选择”，核心原则如下：</p>

























<table><thead><tr><th>需求场景</th><th>推荐方案</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>需保证顺序、逐个执行</td><td>for...of + await</td></tr><tr><td>追求速度、独立请求</td><td>Promise.all() + map()</td></tr><tr><td>需保留所有结果（含失败）</td><td>Promise.allSettled()/try-catch</td></tr><tr><td>需控制并发数、遵守限流</td><td>p-limit 等工具</td></tr></tbody></table>
